items.title: RAPID Scholars Get-Together 2025 in FCCU
items.body:
The Rapid Charity (Lahore Chapter) hosted a beautiful get-together with our scholarship recipients and alumni on 6th December 2025. In 2025, 147 scholarships were awarded across Pakistan, and it was amazing to seeing so many bright faces gathered in one place.

Rapid alumni scholars shared their stories: the challenges they’ve faced, the successes they’ve celebrated, and the opportunities they’re embracing. Each voice carried deep gratitude for Rapid Charity’s support.

We were honored to welcome Dr. Jonathan S. Addleton, Rector - Forman Christian College University as our Guest of Honour. Rapid Charity's CEO, The Rev. Dr. Khushnud Azariah, delivered a powerful message of hope and strength that left everyone inspired.

items.title: RAPID-Peshawar Chapter, Get-together October 2023
items.body: RAPID-Peshawar Chapter Get-together 2023 was organized at Christian Study Center Rawalpindi. In this event 17 students from Peshawar and Rawalpindi were present. Mr. Emmanuel Azariah was guest of honor, He spent time with the John-Ivy Azariah Scholarship recipients and emphasized on the importance of professional education for our community, and motivated students to continue to work hard to achieve their dreams.
